question: Q-N-S1-D3
text: Compare monthly gross trip revenue for pickups in the Airports service zone, 2024 vs 2023.
interpretation: Monthly gross trip revenue for pickups in the 'Airports' service zone, 2024 vs 2023.
assemble: SELECT calendar_month, MAX(CASE WHEN pickup_year = 2023 THEN revenue END) AS revenue_2023, MAX(CASE WHEN pickup_year = 2024 THEN revenue END) AS revenue_2024, MAX(CASE WHEN pickup_year = 2024 THEN revenue END) / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN pickup_year = 2023 THEN revenue END), 0) - 1 AS change_pct FROM q WHERE trips > 0 GROUP BY calendar_month ORDER BY calendar_month
